instruction: Launch VLC media player and play the online video from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=60ItHLz5WEA

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation of VLC streaming task with a different YouTube video URL (Faded - Alan Walker). Uses the same evaluator pattern (is_vlc_playing with url type). Instruction uses 'Launch VLC and play' phrasing while maintaining identical task complexity.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: VLC is playing AND the correct URL is loaded
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly extracts VLC status via HTTP interface to status.xml
Metric (is_vlc_playing) has robust URL matching logic with multiple fallback methods (direct match, filename match, domain comparison)
Expected value handling is correct: metric receives rule dict directly and accesses rule['type'] and rule['url']
Complete coverage: both launching VLC and playing the specific URL are verified
Good edge case handling: missing URL info, VLC not playing, various URL formats
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor consideration: YouTube URLs may redirect to different stream URLs in VLC, but the metric already handles this with domain/path comparison fallbacks
